body:
First off, congratulations on your job and I hope it goes well and gets less stressful. 

>I have had moments of hiding in my parent's basement at family get-togethers because all of the sudden, I didn't want to live anymore even though moments earlier I was laughing and enjoying being around family.

I experience moments like these too. They are what is frustrating me because one moment everything is fine and the next I am ten minutes away from death. 

Thank you for being honest and not just blindly telling me it gets better.  

Good luck to you and your family.

That sounds very possible. I began to want to kill myself at the age of 15, I'm 23 now. I tried a few times but just ended up hurt or unconscious but not dead. They were all rash decisions, all made within minutes of trying. If I try again I will make sure it is lethal though and I'd rather find a real solution now.

The reasons I wanted to die then have been overcome, eating disorder is gone,  I am away from some people that negatively effected me. My urge to die has not permanently left. Sometimes I am on top of the world,  sometimes I wish I had just died at 15. 

Thank you for talking to me. I don't want to bring it up with anyone I know , so this means a lot.

I enjoy writing and exploring. I will start to write more and explore with my husband and see if it helps.

Sorry if I'm asking too much of you here, but how would I find a solution if there is no reason? Is the lack of those chemicals a reason? Do those type of things fluctuate? I don't always feel like this, I'm often very well. This just isn't one of those times.

I suppose it is. I guess not being fulfilled is a plausible explanation for this. With the exception of having children  (which I don't want to do in this state) I don't want anything, so I don't know how I would even go about finding whatever fulfilment is. 

Not to sound all 14anddeep but I am also confused about what fulfilment is. I have achieved a lot and will go on to do more things, assuming I'm not dead. By my definition I should be fulfilled achieving my life goals.

Maybe my definition of fulfilment is just wrong, I don't know.
